action_args.justification: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (slope agreement 0.995) with stable model ranking (Kendall tau 0.797, FT_catboost always top-3). The leader (trimmed_mean on the 9 most stable models) and runner-up differ by only 0.00017 in score — statistically indistinguishable with 3 validation windows. The trimmed mean on a stable pool is well-suited to this regime: it captures the consistent signal from trend- and seasonality-aware models while trimming the influence of the few weaker members, and the robustness of trimming is preferable to fitted weights given the high variance of weight estimation over only 3 windows.
